verdict.rationale: Asana markets 'Asana Dash' as an AI chief-of-staff-style natural-language assistant, AI Teammates, and AI Studio no-code automations, and it also ships an official MCP server that would let AI agents issue natural-language-driven actions. However, there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming how well natural-language command actually works end-to-end, and much of the docs pack is about APIs/webhooks/app components rather than NL interaction itself. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of natural-language command execution, detailed docs/demo of Dash's NL capabilities, and confirmation MCP server supports full task-management command set.
